verdict.rationale: WorkOS is an identity platform, and a platform like this could plausibly offer user-configured background automations, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no such feature. Directory Sync's automatic directory updates are a built-in sync, not automations a user sets up. The MCP server lets an external agent act on the workspace when invoked, which is not autonomous background execution. Neither counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
